summary: Iteration 19 — Spot the Difference Curated Library backend (priority) + frontend smoke. Created /app/backend/tests/test_spot_library.py (16 tests across 6 classes). Pytest result: 16/16 PASS (100%). All required endpoints verified: GET /api/games/spot/library returns exactly 12 launch puzzles (p001-p012), no Christmas (x001/x002 correctly excluded mid-June 2026); card shape for p003 matches spec (title 'Sunset at the beach', photo_url '/api/static/spot_bg/library/beach_sunset.jpg', theme 'beaches', difficulty 'easy', season null). GET /api/games/spot/library/p003 returns full playable puzzle with title, background_url, scene_a, scene_b, differences, diff_count, and puzzle_id prefix 'lib:p003:'; deterministic across same-day calls. GET /api/games/spot/library/p999 → 404. GET /api/games/spot/daily → curated rotation (puzzle_id starts 'lib:', curated title 'Sunset at the beach' today, background_url under /library/, is_daily true, season null since mid-June). Legacy GET /api/games/spot/catalog and GET /api/games/spot/puzzle?theme=beaches&difficulty=easy still work (legacy puzzle_id 'std:beaches:easy:<seed>'). POST /api/games/spot/progress/{uid} for puzzle_id 'lib:p003:<seed>' persists (GET returns same theme/difficulty/found_ids/completed flag); Hard completion grants >0 points; repeat-submit awards 0 (idempotent); Easy completion awards 0 (spec: Hard/Nightmare only). Static photos: beach_sunset.jpg, garden_morning.jpg, cafe_window.jpg, kitchen_baking.jpg, trail_eucalypt.jpg all return 200 with image content-type and non-trivial size. Frontend smoke at 390x844 mobile viewport: 12 std-lib-* thumbnails render, EASY + MODERATE badges visible, no Christmas badge (correct for June), tap std-lib-p001 navigates to /games/spot/play?lib=p001&btc=0, header shows curated title 'Morning in the back garden', scenes render. Today's Daily card on hub shows curated title 'Sunset at the beach' and 'Easy · 3 differences' summary. No backend or frontend bugs found in this scope.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.', 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — non-blocking, pre-existing from previous iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: spot_library.py is clean: PUZZLES list of 14 entries (12 always-on + 2 Christmas seasonal), _season_active correctly handles year-wrap for Christmas (Nov 25–Dec 31 OR Jan 1–Jan 5), public_card omits the scene callable so JSON serialization is safe.

server.py:1766-1818 — library, library/{id}, and daily endpoints reuse std_generate(theme, difficulty, seed) cleanly and then override puzzle_id/title/background_url/season. Seed is deterministic on (puzzle_id, today) so a returning player gets the same layout same-day, and daily rotation hashes ("daily|<today_iso>") for a stable per-day pick.
Progress endpoint accepts puzzle_id verbatim (lib:..., std:..., or any string) which is correct — the puzzle_id is used only as an idempotency key + display string.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke check passed — 12 thumbs render, badges correct, navigation + curated title verified

seed_data_creation: Two test spot_progress docs were upserted under demo user maggie for puzzle_ids 'lib:p003:test-hard-<pid>' and 'lib:p003:test-easy-<pid>'. These are harmless test rows; can be removed via db.spot_progress.delete_many({puzzle_id: /^lib:p003:test-/}) if cleanup desired. Maggie also received points from the Hard completion test — single transaction, expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All curated library endpoints + static photos pass. Frontend hub uses testID 'std-lib-<puzzle_id>' for each thumbnail card (e.g. std-lib-p001…std-lib-p012), 'std-daily' for the daily card, 'std-btc' for the Beat-the-Clock switch. Library puzzle_id format is 'lib:<id>:<seed>' or 'lib:<id>:daily-<YYYY-MM-DD>' for the daily. POST /api/games/spot/progress/{uid} requires theme to be in STD_THEMES and difficulty to be in STD_DIFFS (the library puzzle's theme is the same key, so this works transparently). Christmas puzzles (x001, x002) are only active Nov 25 – Jan 5. If the user re-runs near year-end, expect 14 puzzles in the list and a 🎄 badge in the UI.
